_about: PROPOSED externalized thresholds for the McProof sizing generator (sizing.mjs, to be built by lane T). Same pattern as city-approve.config.json: each value has a one-line reason; changing one is a ruling (MCPROOF-10). Values are the orchestrator's proposal; the operator confirms. v4.1 (fold-validation/v4.md folded). v4 added stage_order_gate, quick_arithmetic_skips_stage5 and answer_table_required (CARD-mcproof-lessons items 1 to 3).

full_review_increments.reason: Increment 1 is the foundation; the operator approved a full six-stage review once (CARD-mcproof-sizing).

quick_path_stages.reason: Operator card: quick path = stage 0 Reality check + stage 5 Calculation check.

agreement_min_share.reason: DeepSeek blind and the Claude check must agree on at least 95% of the examples reviewed in full, so one stray miss does not block sampling but a pattern of misses does (mirrors city-approve min_share_overall).

agreement_min_sample.reason: A share on fewer than 20 fully reviewed examples is too thin to trust (mirrors city-approve min_n_overall).

agreement_scope.reason: Agreement is counted within one increment and one layer: agreement in one layer says nothing about another; Reading and Inputs examples fail differently from Arithmetic ones.

sample_seed.reason: A fixed seed makes the seeded hash of the example id reproducible, so the sample is never hand-picked and can be re-derived.

tolerance_area_m2.reason: Areas agree within 0.005 m2 (the rounding contract of the stage 5 prompt, promoted to config so the pass rule cannot change by editing a prompt).

tolerance_other.reason: Other numbers agree within 1e-9 on the 9-place figure (same contract).

operator_spot_check_share.reason: Operator card 2026-10-31 item 2: 10 percent of all-approved examples, at least 1 per chapter.

sample_share.reason: Once sampling starts, 20% of examples are reviewed in full, chosen by a seeded hash of the example id so the choice is not hand-picked.

sample_min_per_layer.reason: Every layer in the increment keeps at least 3 fully reviewed examples.

sample_miss_reverts.reason: Any disagreement inside a sample puts the whole layer back to full review for that increment.

never_quick_layers.reason: A Ruling is the operator's product decision; no data or agreement can stand in for it.

max_fix_rounds.reason: After 2 failed fix rounds the example is parked and goes to the operator (queue MB-27 'After K rounds').

max_retries_per_stage.reason: A crashed or empty seat run is retried twice, then recorded as errored; it is never n/a.

recent_min_distinct_applications.reason: PROPOSED change to city-approve.config.json: five recent lines from one application are one voice, not five.

stage_order_gate.reason: CARD-mcproof-lessons item 1: stage 0 and City data found almost every defect (MB-64/review/REVIEW.round2.md:5-11), so they finish over the whole set before any blind or recompute call.

low_risk_arithmetic.reason: CARD-mcproof-lessons item 2 'per the approved sizing': no criterion beyond CARD-mcproof-sizing's quick path.

quick_arithmetic_skips_stage5.reason: Operator decision, CARD-mcproof-lessons.answered.md item 2 ('Skip the blind check and the recompute on low-risk Arithmetic examples'): stages 3 and 5 are skipped, stages 0 and 4 kept (no arithmetic error found: MB-64/review/REVIEW.md:36, REVIEW.round2.md:92). Overrides CARD-mcproof-sizing's stage-5 quick path for low-risk Arithmetic only. Changing the value is a ruling and invalidates the recorded n/a reasons.

answer_table_required.reason: CARD-mcproof-lessons item 3: critique-only replies (MB-64/review/REVIEW.md:37, REVIEW.round2.md:98) never count as an answer; the stage is errored and retried up to max_retries_per_stage.
